summary: Core fix is correct: get_feature_names (and inverse_transform) now call _validate_vocabulary() before _check_vocabulary(), resolving the NotFittedError-when-vocabulary-provided issue consistently. However the patch also inserts a redundant duplicate of the existing 'if not hasattr(self, vocabulary_): self._validate_vocabulary()' block in transform, which is dead no-op code that a maintainer would reject.

issues.description: transform() now contains the validate-vocabulary block twice in a row; the second copy is unreachable/no-op since the first already sets vocabulary_. Obvious accidental copy-paste duplication that should be removed before merge.
The duplicated block hurts readability and signals careless editing; collapse to the single existing check.
